title: Ikala character bodyPlan
description: A rig plus the variants, body slots, clothing layers, sockets, extension chains, sliders and IK setup built on it. Any part or clip made for a plan works on every character of that plan.

BodyPlan.description: A rig plus the variants, body slots, clothing layers, sockets, extension chains, sliders and IK setup built on it. Any part or clip made for a plan works on every character of that plan.

rig.description: The rig it is built on.

variants.description: Its variants, like male and female, which share the rig's bones.

slots.description: Body slots, which body parts fill, joined at seam rings.

layers.description: Clothing and armor layers, which overlap body slots and hide what they cover.

sockets.description: Attach points for accessories and held items.

equipment.description: Equipment slots, which gameplay items go in, each drawn in a layer or held in a socket. Earlier slots' item styles come first.

extensions.description: Optional bone chains, like a tail, wings or a cape.

sliders.description: The sliders it uses, as IDs or patterns ending in *, like "ikala:slider/biped/*".

channels.description: Palette channels beyond the standard ones (skin, eyes, hair, primary, secondary, tertiary, accent), like "fur".

exclusiveTags.description: Tags a character wears at most one part of each, like "cloth" for long coats, capes and robes, or "backDetail" for wings, jetpacks and backpacks. The last one put on takes the others off.

forms.description: Shapes clothing is fitted to, thinnest first: shells over the body, each a share of every slot's radius out, like "tight" at 0 and "bulky" at 0.45. A body part names the thinnest its surface fits in; on a clothed slot it must fit in the thickest unless clothing can't go over it.

decals.description: Places a design's decal can go, like "chest": a box fixed to a bone at rest that art is projected through onto the parts covering its slots.

regions.description: Mask region names that body meshes tag their triangles with, so layers can hide them. At most 64.

boneGroups.description: Named sets of bones, for masking animation layers, like "upperBody".

collision.description: How the collision capsule is placed.

extends.description: The ID of a definition of the same kind to start from. Fields written here replace the parent's, and objects merge field by field.

Collider.description: A capsule around the body, from one bone's head to another's.

from.description: The bone at one end, like "thigh.L".

to.description: The bone at the other end, like "shin.L".

radius.description: How thick it is, in meters.

Collision.description: How the collision capsule is placed.

capsuleFromBones.description: The two bones the capsule spans, bottom first.

radiusScale.description: The radius as a share of the capsule's height.

DecalPlace.description: A place a design's decal can go: a box fixed to a bone at rest, facing the character's front, that art is projected through.

bone.description: The bone the box is fixed to, like "chest".

offset.description: Where the box's middle is from the bone, in the character's space at rest, in meters.

size.description: The art's width and height, in meters.

depth.description: How deep the box is, front to back, in meters: enough for the thickest clothing, not the body's back.

covers.description: The body slots whose parts, and the layers covering which, show the decal, like ["torso"].

EquipmentSlot.description: An equipment slot, like "head" or "mainHand", and where its items are drawn.

layer.description: The layer items in it are drawn in, like "helmet".

sockets.description: The sockets, or socket types, items in it can be held in, like "grip.R" or "back.large".

Extension.description: An optional bone chain, skipped when no part uses it.

bones.description: Its bones, from the root outward, each the next one's parent.

spring.description: How it swings on its own, following the pose clips give it. Left out, it holds its pose.

Form.description: A shape clothing is fitted to: a shell over the body, a share of each slot's radius out.

share.description: How far out from the body its shell is, as a share of each slot's radius.

feet.description: The leg chains that foot IK plants.

lookAt.description: The bones that turn to look at a target, and how much each turns.

order.description: Where it stacks; higher goes over lower, like shirt 10 < jacket 20.

standoff.description: How far its clothing usually stands out from the body part under it, as a share of each slot's radius, so accessories resting on a slot it covers sit on it. A part can give its own.

reach.description: The furthest out its clothing may stand from the body part under it, as a share of each slot's radius, so the layers over it cover it. Left out, there is no limit.

chain.description: The bones from the hip to the foot, each the next one's parent.

LookAt.description: One bone's share of looking at a target.

weight.description: How much of the turn it takes, 0 to 1.

Rest.description: Where accessories on a socket rest on the body.

slot.description: The body slot they rest on, like "torso".

out.description: Which way they move out from it, in the character's space at rest: x across, y up, z forward, like [0, 0, -1] for the back.

SliderSetting.description: A variant's setting for one slider.

range.description: The values allowed, as [min, max], within the slider's own.

Slot.description: A body slot, which one body part fills.

bones.description: The bones a part in this slot may weight.

seams.description: The seam rings at its edges, shared with neighboring slots.

mirrorOf.description: The matching slot on the other side, for mirrored parts.

optional.description: Whether the slot may be left empty, like a tail.

clothed.description: Whether clothing goes over its body parts, like a torso or a leg but not a hand, so they must fit in the thickest clothing form unless clothing can't go over them.

radius.description: How thick it is on the rig's reference body: the median distance of its surface from its long axis, in meters. Clothing forms and how far clothing stands out are shares of it.

bone.description: The bone it is on, like "socket.back".

max.description: How many items it holds at once.

type.description: Its type tag, which items fit by, like "grip.1h" or "back.large".

rests.description: The body slot accessories on it rest on, and which way they move out as the part and clothing there stand further out than the bare body they were fitted on. Left out, they stay put.

Spring.description: How a chain swings on its own: each joint is pulled toward where clips pose it, falls, slows, trails behind as the character moves, and keeps out of the body.

stiffness.description: How hard each joint is pulled toward where clips pose it, per second squared.

damping.description: How much of its speed each joint loses each second.

gravity.description: How much gravity pulls it, as a share of Earth's.

drag.description: How much moving forward pushes it back, per second: the push is the character's speed times this.

colliders.description: Capsules around the body it keeps out of, like the legs for a cape.

Variant.description: A variant, sharing the plan's bones with its own proportions and limits.

tags.description: Parts must have one of these tags to be used on it. Empty allows any part.

sliders.description: Slider settings for this variant, by slider ID.

parts.description: The part each body slot or layer starts with, by slot or layer name, which designs that leave a slot out fall back to. Slots left out here start empty.

radii.description: Its body slots' radii, in meters, where they differ from the plan's reference body's.
